reviews.title: Long wake windows
reviews.text: I just barely downloaded this app and it worked great for one single morning but now it’s trying to tell me I need to keep my 3 month old awake for 3 hours after every nap she has???? She’s only took a 30 minute nap and it pushed her next nap time back FURTHER. What the hell?????? No way I’m doing that, make a better app next time

reviews.title: Can’t even get to the actual app

Are we serious ? $20 a month to log sleep, it’s actually ridiculous you can’t use the apps basic features without paying.

reviews.title: App is now useless due to paid upgrades

reviews.text: Why on this green earth would you have a slider bar Wen going to input a bottle so I’m trying to feed my baby his bottle and you’re telling me I have to drag the bar all the way to 8 ounces instead of just typing the number eight. It makes no sense and it’s frustrating.

reviews.title: Not the best

reviews.title: So bad
reviews.text: The app recommended my 14 week old to have 2 hour 15 minute wake windows and 15 minute apps. Absolute disaster

reviews.title: Poor data vis but decent for sleep
reviews.text: The data page on this is a generic AI vibe coded page of graphs without any sort of meaningful data interaction. They do not really do all that much. You also cannot export your data or change / modify how it’s shown. Bit of BS for the price. The nursing timer is horrible to use! It’s structured as “pauses” rather than displaying the total time per breast.  My only disclaimer is we’ve used this with our infant before 8 weeks so haven’t seen the recommendations, but it’s pointless so far and creates so much screen time with baby.

reviews.title: There’s better
reviews.text:
To be honest I think this app could be way better than it is. They took out money for an annual subscription and I couldn’t get the money back, so I paid for an app I actually didn’t like. 
You can’t log as much and I feel it’s very pushy for when it thinks your child should sleep. When I used its schedule my baby would wake 6+ times a night, now my baby wakes once if at all. Just follow your baby

reviews.title: Annoying Ads
reviews.text: I used to pay for premium but my baby is 10 months now so I still use the app but don’t need the insights really. Now whenever I open the app I can’t get to the actual Home Screen because of these dumb ads to pay for premium. I DONT WANT YOUR SUMMER SALE, JUST LET ME LOG A NAP.

reviews.title: La IA ayudó más que la app con el sueño de mi bebé
reviews.text:
Estaba un poco desesperada por el mal dormir de mi bebé, por lo que pagué la suscripción anual e intenté seguir las recomendaciones de la app dentro de lo que mi bebé permitía. Sin embargo, seguía despertándose cada una hora.

Finalmente recurrí a un chat de IA, que me recomendó que las siestas duraran al menos 45 minutos y que hiciera lo posible para que volviera a dormirse si despertaba antes. Si ya no era posible, me sugirió dejar de insistir para evitar que se sobrecansara y, desde ahí, calcular la siguiente siesta. Mientras tanto, la app me proponía algunas siestas con una duración objetivo de apenas 37 o 38 minutos.

Al seguir los consejos de la IA, esa misma noche mi bebé logró un tramo de sueño de 4 horas seguidas. Por eso, creo que terminaré perdiendo el año de suscripción o simplemente usaré la aplicación como una agenda para registrar horarios.

Pienso que sería muy útil que incorporaran una IA como asistente y consejera, ya que todos los bebés son distintos y las causas de los problemas de sueño pueden ser muy variadas

reviews.title: Update with p.i.t.a. Ad
reviews.text: The most recent update means every time I go into the app I’m presented with an ad to get the premium version at a reduced rate. Clicking to exit the ad never works so instead of being able to see/track naps I now spend a minute trying to get the advert to disappear. Currently searching for another app to use!

reviews.title: Love it but have one little suggestion
reviews.text:
Adore the app, apart from being so aesthetically pleasing, I appreciate the dark background so when I check things in the app there is no bright screen to disrupt the environment I’ve created for my baby’s sleep. Prices are convenient for subscription and I appreciate that it gives you nap predictions without having a subscription. The only reason I am giving it a 4 star review is not because I would change something but rather add something. It would be nice to have all the nap and wake up times in list form. To me, that is easier to see and I can have log ready to screenshot when I need to send it to someone. 
Other thank that, great app. Please add the list format 😁

reviews.title: To save you the time as it doesn’t tell you…
reviews.text: I knew it wouldn’t be free but couldn’t see the cost anywhere to save you searching the only option is an annual subscription after a 7 day free trial and it’s £39.99

reviews.title: Linda
reviews.text:
Fin app for tracking av dagsøvn, den beregner og treffer bra på det. Hvis du også liker å tracke alt annet (mat, bleieskift) er den også fin men blir da uoversiktlig i oversiktsbildet… appen gjør derimot ikke dagsøvnen bedre! Den hjelper kun med å gi indikasjon på når neste lur er.
For vår del var det nattesøvn som var utfordringen, og mine forhåpninger var at appen kunne hjelpe med å tilpasse tips og råd om akkurat oss i enda større grad, noe den ikke gjør. Den er også lite brukervenning feks på natt hvis man skal logge søvnen da hjulet er knotete og klokka «hopper» ved logging av tidligere søvn.

Toppen av kransekaka var vel at det tok rett over en uke for appen å «perfeksjonere» beregningene sine- altså rett etter den gratis prøveperioden er over. Så blir man altså trukket 500kr for en app som ikke funker! Utspekulert…

reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.text: This app was helpful for me when my baby’s naps seemed to be all over the place and unpredictable. But my baby is just not a great sleeper in general and took 3 short naps until about 8 months of age which drove me crazy. This app did not help him take longer naps but it did help me track his sleep in general. Also it did not take into account night wakes or offer any ideas or solutions so again it was just an app to track sleep. So in my opinion it should not cost as much as it did.

reviews.title: Statistics don’t update during sleep
reviews.text:
During night time sleep the “all sleep” and “nighttime sleep” values don’t update and stay at 0. This is super frustrating as I’d love to see how much my baby has slept in order to decide whether to encourage it to keep sleeping or not. During the day the “daytime sleep”
And “all sleep” values only update unreliably. Sometimes they do, sometimes they don’t automatically and only when I add a brief nap pause which then seems to trigger a refresh. please fix!!

reviews.title: Poco atingente
reviews.text: Llevo 14 días usando Napper y dice constantemente: calibrando. Mi bebé tiene un desorden del sueño y Napper no me señala que dormir seis siestas diarias no es normal en un bebé de 4 meses. Solo me pide registrar y me avisa: le toca dormir, más no calibrando ni aconseja de forma realista. No señala si la hora de acostarse es muy tarde o inadecuada. Solo ha generado que mi bebé duerma muchas siestas pero muy cortas y poco reparadoras.

reviews.title: Wake windows way too long
reviews.text: I had the napper app (paid version) for a couple months for my 5-6 month old to get a handle on her naps because we were struggling with short naps and getting the last nap in everyday. It said that it was 100 percent accurate and that it had learned her sleep cycles enough to make her ideal schedule, so this isn’t a review of the first few weeks using it. This app suggested her morning wake window be 3 hours long (which is too long for her) and then she’d only nap 35 min. Her second wake window would be like 3 hours and 45 mins. (Again, too long) giving us a short second nap and when it would suggest a third nap time- it would be so late in the day, putting her bed time a couple hours later than it should be. So if we’d skip the nap, the app would only change her bedtime by like 15 mins, suggesting her last wake window be up to 6 hours long. For a 6 month old!! I finally stopped using it, gave much shorter wake windows, and we are now getting 1-2 hour long naps regularly capping wake windows at 3-3.5 hours in the evening. Don’t waste your time or money.
